what_its_for: Lifitegrast eye drops are used to treat the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease. It helps reduce eye redness, irritation, and discomfort caused by dry eyes by calming the inflammation on the surface of your eyes.
how_to_take: Wash your hands thoroughly before using. Tilt your head back, gently pull down your lower eyelid to create a small pocket, and place one drop into each eye. Close your eye gently for 1 to 2 minutes — try not to blink or squeeze your eye shut. If you wear contact lenses, remove them before putting in the drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting your contacts back in. Avoid touching the tip of the dropper to your eye, finger, or any other surface to prevent contamination.
dosing: Use one drop in each eye two times a day (morning and evening), about 12 hours apart. Use the drops exactly as your doctor prescribed — do not use more or less than directed.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not use extra drops to make up for a missed dose.
storage: Store the individual single-use containers (vials) in their original foil pouch at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep them away from direct sunlight and moisture. Each vial is for one-time use only — throw away any leftover solution in the vial after each use, even if there is medicine remaining. Keep all medications out of the reach of children.
what_to_avoid: Avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface to prevent contamination and eye infection. Do not use while wearing contact lenses — remove them first and wait 15 minutes before reinserting. Avoid driving or doing activities that require clear vision right after using the drops, as they may temporarily blur your vision. Do not use other eye drops at the same time unless your doctor approves — wait at least 15 minutes between different eye medications.
when_to_call_doctor: Contact your doctor if you experience: severe eye pain or increased eye discomfort after using the drops; signs of an eye infection such as increased redness, discharge, or swelling; blurred vision that does not go away within a short time; an allergic reaction such as rash, itching, or swelling of the face or throat; or if your dry eye symptoms are not improving or are getting worse after several weeks of treatment.
when_it_works: Many patients begin to notice some improvement in their dry eye symptoms within 2 to 6 weeks of regular use. However, it may take up to 3 months to experience the full benefit of the medication. It is important to keep using the drops every day as prescribed, even if you do not notice immediate improvement.
special_populations: Pregnant or breastfeeding women should talk to their doctor before using lifitegrast, as its safety during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been fully established. Lifitegrast is not approved for use in children under 17 years of age. Elderly patients generally do not require a dose adjustment. If you have any other eye conditions or are using other eye medications, discuss this with your doctor or pharmacist before starting lifitegrast.
